title: DD-subreport-detail-rows coverage analysis — 3 critical gaps, 12 important gaps found
body:
Completed coverage analysis of DD-subreport-detail-rows.md against the tableflip codebase.

COVERED (18 modules correctly addressed):
types.ts, core/state.ts, core/state-serializer.ts, core/state-hydrator.ts, core/state-schema.ts, catalog/column-catalog.ts, query/sql-detail-bands.ts (new), query/query-plan.ts (reference), query/resolve-ref.ts (unchanged), report/engine.ts, report/result-set.ts, report/validation.ts, report/report-output.ts, ui/sections/detail-band-stage.tsx (new), ui/cards/pipeline-card.tsx, ui/grid.tsx (phase 4), ui/export.ts, constraints (quoteId, invalidateValidation, window guards, vendored CJS).

CRITICAL GAPS (3):
1. index.ts — barrel exports missing for DetailBandSpec, buildBandQuery, BandQueryResult, DetailBandStage, createDetailBandSpec
2. run-bar.tsx — ReportSpec construction (lines 68-100) doesn't include detailBands/detailBandMode, so engine never receives band config
3. report-graph.ts — buildReportGraph() refs array (line 77-81) doesn't include detailBands[].rightId for dependency tracking

IMPORTANT GAPS (12):
4. grid.tsx (line 334) — _band_id not filtered from visible columns
5. merge-toggles.tsx (line 30) — _band_id not filtered from display cols
6. column-chips.tsx — 7 call sites build reportSpec as {base,lookups,calcStages} without detailBands, so band columns won't appear in projectedCols/selCols/colOrder
7-11. sort-list.tsx, filter-list.tsx, layout-card.tsx, calc-stage.tsx, lookup-stage.tsx — same reportSpec construction pattern missing detailBands
12. alias-ref-updater.ts — doesn't propagate column renames to detailBands keyPairs/cols
13. query-plan.ts — catalogCtx construction needs detailBands for buildColumnCatalog()
14. engine.ts runTotalsMode() — catalogCtx needs detailBands
15. 11 existing test files need updates for new state shape

NICE-TO-HAVE: vitest.config.ts, vitest-setup.ts, tsconfig.json — no changes needed.

BIGGEST RISK: The reportSpec construction pattern `{base, lookups, calcStages}` appears in 8+ UI components. Without updating all of them to include `detailBands`, band columns will be invisible to the column catalog, chip selectors, layout cards, and filter/sort UIs.

title: Pattern consistency review: Plan A (TASK-subreport-detail-rows-A-mvp) — all 15 PE amendments verified
body:
Completed pattern consistency review of Plan A (TASK-subreport-detail-rows-A-mvp). All 15 PE amendments verified:

**PE-1 (barrel exports):** ✅ All 5 exports present in index.ts — createDetailBandSpec (Core), buildBandQuery + BandQueryResult (Query), DetailBandStage (UI), DetailBandSpec (Types).

**PE-2 (run-bar.tsx):** ✅ detailBands and detailBandMode included in ReportSpec construction with defensive fallbacks.

**PE-3 (report-graph.ts):** ✅ detailBands[].rightId included in dependency refs array.

**PE-4 (grid.tsx):** ✅ _band_id filtered from makeResultCols() alongside _rowno, _row_type, _isTotalsRow.

**PE-5 (merge-toggles.tsx):** ✅ _band_id filtered from display columns.

**PE-6 through PE-11 (buildReportSpecFromState):** ✅ All 13 inline ReportSpec constructions replaced across 6 files (column-chips×7, sort-list×1, filter-list×1, layout-card×1, calc-stage×2, lookup-stage×1). Confirmed via grep — 19 call sites across 7 files.

**PE-12 (alias-ref-updater.ts):** ✅ detailBands[].keyPairs[].left and detailBands[].cols updated on column rename.

**PE-13/PE-14 (catalogCtx in buildQueryPlan/runTotalsMode):** Correctly SKIPPED/BLOCKED — adding band columns to the colMap used by buildDetailQuery()/buildTotalsQuery() causes 'no such column' SQL errors because the FROM clause has no JOIN to band tables. Band columns only work in runDetailBandsMode() which builds its own catalogCtx. Documented as dead-end L40.

**PE-15 (test fixtures):** ✅ All 11 test files updated. 672/672 tests pass.

**Pattern consistency:** DetailBandSpec mirrors LookupSpec pattern (rightId, keyPairs, cols, enabled). createDetailBandSpec mirrors createLookupSpec (Object.assign + overrides). DetailBandStage mirrors LookupStage (store.subscribe, table picker, key pairs, column chips, invalidateValidation). PipelineCard integration follows same rendering pattern as lookups/calcs.

**Issues found:**
- IMPORTANT: merge-toggles.tsx line 23 still uses inline `{ base, lookups, calcStages }` — not a PE requirement but a consistency gap (detail-band-stage.tsx line 74 is intentionally inline because left-side key columns shouldn't include band columns).
- MINOR: No sort configuration UI in DetailBandStage (data model + query gen support sorts, but UI doesn't expose them).
- MINOR: Unused `_sourceCatalog` parameter in buildBandQuery().
- MINOR: buildReportSpecFromState return type is Record<string, unknown> (less type-safe than DD specified, but matches actual consumer expectations).

**No architectural violations or layer boundary crossings detected.** All imports flow downward: UI → Report → Query → Catalog → Core.

title: DD-pipeline-preview coverage validation
body: Completed full codebase validation of DD-pipeline-preview.md. Key findings: buildQueryPlan expects a full ReportSpec (not a partial), buildColSourceMap doesn't call buildReportSpecFromState as DD claims, preview-builder calling execQuery directly violates report-layer convention, and disabled lookup stages may produce incorrect previews due to slice vs. buildColumnCatalog mismatch.

title: DD default-selection-conventions: scope coverage validation
body: Validated scope coverage of DD-default-selection-conventions.md against codebase. Cross-referenced all 7 type fields, 13 pre-audited consumer files, and searched for additional unlisted consumers. Full report follows.

title: coerceForSQL() violates ASR-001 — numeric string coercion
body: Found critical violation: `coerceForSQL()` in SRC/preact/core/sqldb.ts:44-46 unconditionally converts numeric-looking strings to numbers (e.g. "00123" -> 123). This directly contradicts ASR-001's prohibition on "Silent type coercion of cell values (e.g., '00123' → 123)". The test at tests/core/sqldb.test.ts:108-116 explicitly tests and expects this behavior. Also: boolean coercion (true → 1, false → 0) at line 42.

title: sidebar.tsx DROP violates ADR-001 letter
body: Found minor violation: sidebar.tsx:37 calls `dropTable(id)` directly when user removes a table. ADR-001 prohibits DROP on source tables after ingestSheet() returns. This is a user-facing feature (intentional table removal), so the ADR may need amending to permit user-initiated deletion. Currently a technical violation of ADR-001 as written.

title: DD-store-alias-rename.md validation complete
body: Validated DD-store-alias-rename.md against the codebase. Found 3 genuine gap categories: colTotals/subtotalFns Record-type fields, aggModeState nested snapshots, and detail band sorts[].col unnecessary coverage. Generated full structured report.

title: DD-store-alias-rename.md validation: PASS
body: Re-validated DD-store-alias-rename.md after amendment fixing 3 gaps (colTotals, subtotalFns, aggModeState). All gaps covered with correct specs, implementation sketches, and test cases. No new gaps introduced. Document is internally consistent. Verdict: PASS.

title: CSS cleanup not propagated to public/ directory
body: The CSS cleanup in Plan E Phase 2 reduced SRC/css/style.css from 793 to 437 lines, but the copy in SRC/public/css/style.css (which Vite serves as /css/style.css via publicDir) was not updated. The application was loading the old uncleaned CSS. Fixed during audit by copying the cleaned CSS over.

title: pipeline-card.tsx uses raw getStore().subscribe()
body: Plan D required all getStore().subscribe() calls to be replaced with useStore(). But pipeline-card.tsx line 55 still has: useEffect(() => getStore().subscribe(() => { setPreviews({}); }), []). This is a side-effect subscription to clear preview cache on any store change, not a state subscription. Using useStore would cause unnecessary re-renders. Legitimate exception but violates plan criteria.

title: Lint warnings remain in useStore.test.tsx
body: Two ESLint warnings persist in preact/tests/ui/useStore.test.tsx at lines 160 and 186: 'renderCount' is assigned a value but never used. These are false positives (the variable is used via closure in a component function), but Plan E required zero lint warnings.

title: Stale Preact comments in pure-logic files
body: export.ts (lines 7-9) and vitest-setup.ts (lines 20, 24) and aggregation.ts (line 9) contain stale comments referencing "preact" — these are files that were explicitly out of scope for conversion (pure logic files), but the comments are misleading. They should say "the preact directory" or be removed.

title: row-explosion-dialog.tsx deleted post-conversion
body: The DD's 25-file inventory includes components/row-explosion-dialog.tsx but it was deleted in post-conversion commit 86c1657 ("detail band fixes... maybe") by xiaden. The file was properly converted before deletion (it only imported the already-converted Modal component). Not a conversion gap — it was removed by separate work.

title: DD-dd-live-chip-table-ui.md validation — CRITICAL_GAPS
body:
## DD Validation: DD-dd-live-chip-table-ui.md

**Verdict: CRITICAL_GAPS**

Found 1 critical gap and 7 minor issues in the design document's scope coverage.

### Critical: File management sidebar unaccounted for
sidebar.tsx (237 lines) handles file import, table list, table removal, preview trigger, and save button. PivotSidebar's specification only includes ColumnPalette + PipelineStages — no file management. The DD says sidebar.tsx "may be replaced/refit" but doesn't specify where the table list and file import UX go.

### Minor issues:
1. aggregation.ts (222 lines) reused but not in unchanged list
2. export.ts (716 lines) reused but not in unchanged list
3. column-chips.tsx orphaned by layout-card.tsx deletion
4. run-bar.tsx orphaned by auto-preview replacement
5. filter-list.tsx / sort-list.tsx not in any file list
6. refreshResultGridLayout/refreshPreviewGridLayout become dead code
7. sidebar.tsx sets activeTab which becomes obsolete

### What DD gets right:
All new/deleted file lists, store unchanged claim, AG Grid preservation, layer boundary, no new deps, stage component reusability, import chain safety.
